quarterly_data.signal: Company IR deck (October 2026), semiconductor business: Lake Materials supplies CVD/ALD precursors (Si precursors TEOS, TriDMAS, TCS; high-k precursors TDMAZ, ZAC, TDMAHf, CpHf; barrier-metal precursors TiCl4, PDMAT; specialty gases) to global memory and foundry customers, described as 'Korea S and H, Japan k, Taiwan T and U, China S'; its range grew from one product (TDMAZ) in 2017 to about 20 items, and the company expects revenue to grow with expanded supply to global top-tier customers. The 'major customer status' slide (page 15 chart) shows its semiconductor customers as Samsung, SK hynix, TSMC, UMC, Kioxia and SMIC. Its timeline (page 6 chart) lists semiconductor-material supply to Kioxia from July 2018 and to Samsung Electronics from August 2018, and revenue of KRW 1,412 hundred million in 2025 (KRW 1,314 hundred million in 2022); 355 employees.
quarterly_data.figure: about 20 semiconductor precursor items; 2025 revenue KRW 1,412 hundred million

quarterly_data.signal: New businesses (IR deck): in all-solid-state battery materials Lake Materials completed process development and a lithium sulfide (Li2S) mass-production plant, and samples are being tested by domestic, U.S. and Chinese companies; in petrochemical catalysts its supported-catalyst plant is completed, with mass-production application and new application evaluations under way (metallocene compound - MAO co-catalyst - supported catalyst full package). The company claims the No. 1 global and China share in high-efficiency solar-cell TMA and No. 1 global share in LED MO precursors. Its roadmap chart (page 15 chart) shows revenue of 1,410 (unit: KRW 100 million) for FY25 and growth to FY27(E) led by catalysts and battery materials (no FY27 value printed).
quarterly_data.figure: Li2S mass-production plant completed; FY25 revenue 1,410 (KRW 100 million)
